meta.title: Bune Quote – AI quote and order processing for distributors
meta.description: From customer email to accurate quote: an AI agent that processes RFQs and purchase orders, checks them against your catalog and ERP, and prepares them for approval. Part of the Bune Ecosystem.

hero.title: From customer email to accurate quote.
hero.subtitle: Our AI agent reads incoming RFQs and purchase orders, including attached PDFs, photos and spreadsheets. It checks them against your product catalog and ERP and puts a ready quote draft in front of your team. You review, approve, and the system sends.

card.subject: Quote – bearings, bolts
steps: 3 line items extracted from email and PDF

problem.title: Processing quote requests by hand costs time, money and orders
problem.subtitle: Incoming requests are never uniform: free text, scanned purchase orders, spreadsheets, a phone photo of a handwritten list, product descriptions instead of part numbers. So most of the work is still manual.

items.title: Slow replies
items.text: Whoever quotes later often loses the order. With emails queuing up, turnaround is measured in hours, sometimes days.

items.title: Manual data entry
items.text: Experienced staff spend their time looking up part numbers, copying quantities and typing orders into the ERP.

items.title: Costly mistakes
items.text: A mistyped quantity or a wrong part number means complaints, returns and unhappy customers.

items.title: Missed inquiries
items.text: In a busy shared inbox it is easy to overlook a request, and nobody measures it.

how.title: It handles the whole process, not just a summary
how.subtitle: The agent prepares every step from the incoming email to the system update. The decision always stays with your team.

steps.title: Watches your channels
steps.text: Your shared inbox and, on request, your company's business chat accounts. It recognizes whether a message is an RFQ, a purchase order, a complaint or a general question.

steps.title: Reads the attachments
steps.text: Extracts part numbers, quantities, delivery dates and customer details from the email or chat message, PDFs, scanned documents, photos and spreadsheets.

steps.title: Checks your systems
steps.text: Finds the products in your catalog and checks prices, stock and the customer's previous orders in your CRM and ERP.

steps.title: Flags open questions
steps.text: Highlights missing or conflicting information, such as an unclear unit of measure or a product it cannot identify.

steps.title: Prepares the quote
steps.text: Drafts the quotation or order entry and writes the reply to the customer.

steps.title: Updates after approval
steps.text: Your colleague reviews and approves. Then the CRM and ERP are updated and the reply goes out, with every step logged.

control.title: Controlled automation, not a black box
control.subtitle: We do not promise fully autonomous order processing. The agent prepares, people decide. That makes it easier to trust, test and roll out.

items.title: Mandatory approval
items.text: No quote or order is sent or entered into the ERP until a colleague approves it.

items.title: Visible uncertainty
items.text: The agent shows what it is unsure about and where each value came from: the email, the PDF or a previous order.

items.title: Full audit trail
items.text: Every step, correction and approval can be traced: who approved what, and when.

items.title: Measurable results
items.text: We continuously measure processing time, correction rate and requests handled, so the results show in numbers.

items.title: Strict data protection
items.text: We handle your data under the GDPR, one of the strictest privacy standards, and sign a data processing agreement with you. Data is stored in the European Union.

items.title: No model training
items.text: Your emails and documents are not used to train models, by us or by the AI providers we use.

items.title: Least privilege
items.text: The agent only accesses the inboxes and systems the task needs. Writing to the ERP is a separately approved step.

items.title: Human oversight
items.text: Approval-based operation and a full audit trail: a person on your team stays accountable for every quote and order.

about.title: The people accountable for your results
about.text: Bune Quote is built by Bune AI Solutions Ltd., a UK company registered in Scotland. We help distributors move AI beyond experiments to tools that run safely and deliver measurable results. You work directly with the people who design your pilot and are responsible for it.

items.q: Do we need to replace our existing systems?
items.a: No. The agent connects to your existing inbox, catalog, CRM and ERP. For older systems without an API, we start with database access or an export and import route.

items.q: What happens if the AI makes a mistake?
items.a: Nothing is sent or entered without approval. The agent flags what it is unsure about and your colleague can correct it. We measure corrections and use them to improve the system.

items.q: Can it handle free-text requests without part numbers?
items.a: Yes, that is its main strength. It uses product descriptions, the customer's own names for items and previous orders to identify the right product, and asks when it is not sure.

items.q: Can it handle orders that arrive by chat?
items.a: Yes, if they arrive on your company's official business account (WhatsApp Business, Facebook Messenger, Viber Business). It processes the text and photographed lists just like emails, and after approval the reply goes back in the same channel. We do not connect to conversations on employees' personal phones; it is worth moving those to a shared business account.
English and Hungarian, and German on request. The reply draft is written in the customer's language.

items.q: How long does it take to get started?
items.a: The pilot runs for 30 days with one inbox and one workflow. After a successful pilot we extend it to more workflows and switch on writing to the ERP.
Every company has different systems and volumes, so after a short review we give you an individual, fixed-price offer for the pilot.
